known.fact: Gives Røjel the order to hit the bridges and sets off around fifteen sabotages across Jutland in the same days.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Attends every Hvidsten drop; his tolerance of parachutists lodging at the inn is the crack the Gestapo later widen.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)
